scope: B 站-shaped pages; feed / nav / tag APIs answered locally; mocked chrome.*

results.test: first homepage visit asks once: 换一批 or 无限下滑
choosing 换一批 saves the mode and the chooser goes away
换一批 mode shows 上一批 / 批次 / 下一批 / 换一批 and says which mode it is
keyword and UID rules hide native cards at once; the toolbar says 已屏蔽 2 个 and why
the master switch turns every rule off and back on
换一批 drops videos the earlier batches already showed (cross-batch dedupe)
无限下滑 mode has no 换一批 / 上一批 / 下一批 at all; the toolbar just says it is the infinite feed
infinite batches never show blocked titles; the batch divider counts what was filtered
a tag rule looks tags up (B 站 tag API) and keeps those videos out, including cards already on screen
⋮ → 按标签屏蔽… shows the video's tags; one click adds the tag to the synced block list
video page: ad slots and game cards hidden by default; opt-in rules (小窗直播) stay until switched on
switches apply live and are mirrored for the next page start (no flash)
